questions.question: Which of the following dance forms is influenced by Bihu dance?
questions.solution: The Sattriya dance form, originating in Assam, is heavily influenced by the Bihu dance. While Sattriya is a classical dance used for spiritual storytelling in monasteries, it incorporates several rhythmic elements and physical postures from the local folk Bihu tradition.

questions.question: The famous musician, Appa Jalgaonkar is associated with which musical instrument?
questions.solution: Appa Jalgaonkar was a legendary maestro of the Harmonium. He was widely respected for his unique style of solo performance and his ability to accompany the greatest vocalists of Hindustani classical music with immense grace.

questions.question: Which folk dance represents a mock fight between Goddess Durga and Mahishasura?
questions.solution: Dandiya Raas is a folk dance from Gujarat that represents a mock fight between Goddess Durga and Mahishasura. The colorful sticks (dandiyas) used during the dance represent the swords of the Goddess as she battles the demon king.

questions.question: In which year was the famous sitar player Pt. Ravi Shankar awarded the Bharat Ratna?
questions.solution: The legendary Sitar maestro Pandit Ravi Shankar was awarded India's highest civilian honor, the Bharat Ratna, in 1999. He was a global ambassador for Indian music and won five Grammy Awards throughout his career.

questions.question: Ustad Allauddin Khan, the legendary sarod player, was from which of the following gharanas of music?
